# Determine indie-genre songs and follow all their artists
login_resp = apis.spotify.login(username='ma_smith@gmail.com', password='XjuXZ2Q')
access_token = login_resp['access_token']

# Re-fetch following artist ids (ensure up-to-date)
following_artist_ids = set()
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_following_artists(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    for a in resp:
        following_artist_ids.add(a['artist_id'])
    page_index += 1

print('currently_following_artist_count', len(following_artist_ids))

# Determine indie songs from previously computed indie_songs if available; otherwise compute from unique_song_ids
try:
    indie_songs_local = indie_songs
    print('using_cached_indie_songs', len(indie_songs_local))
except NameError:
    # compute from unique_song_ids
    indie_songs_local = []
    for sid in unique_song_ids:
        s = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
        if 'indie' in (s.get('genre','') or '').lower():
            indie_songs_local.append({'song_id': sid, 'title': s.get('title'), 'genre': s.get('genre')})
    print('computed_indie_songs', len(indie_songs_local))

# Print indie songs
for x in indie_songs_local:
    print('indie_song', x['song_id'], x.get('title'), 'genre:', x.get('genre'))

# Collect all artists across indie songs
artist_id_to_name = {}
artist_ids = set()
for song in indie_songs_local:
    s = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=song['song_id'])
    for art in s.get('artists', []) or []:
        artist_ids.add(art['id'])
        artist_id_to_name[art['id']] = art.get('name')

print('unique_indie_artists_count', len(artist_ids))
print('indie_artist_ids', sorted(artist_ids))

# Determine which artists we need to follow
artists_to_follow = sorted([aid for aid in artist_ids if aid not in following_artist_ids])
print('artists_already_following', len(artist_ids) - len(artists_to_follow))
print('artists_to_follow_count', len(artists_to_follow))
print('artists_to_follow', [(aid, artist_id_to_name.get(aid)) for aid in artists_to_follow])

# Follow each artist
follow_results = []
for aid in artists_to_follow:
    res = apis.spotify.follow_artist(artist_id=aid, access_token=access_token)
    follow_results.append({'artist_id': aid, 'artist_name': artist_id_to_name.get(aid), 'result': res})
    print('followed', aid, artist_id_to_name.get(aid), '->', res)

print('total_follow_actions', len(follow_results))
